items.title: Andy Anderson Interview, 1960-04-30
items.q: incidentally I saw him a few weeks ago, he's up there on Maple Street

ctx.x: Did they work over there very often?

Oh yeah they worked on Friday, Saturday and Sunday. When Buddy Petit came over to work, he usually worked about a week. He played the vicinity like he'd take us out there. After Buddy Petit, he worked for this fellow LeBlanc. Mr. LeBlanc, he's up there on, incidentally I saw him a few weeks ago, he's up there on Maple Street. So LeBlanc took them over there and had a station wagon, see. Now he booked dances every night, you know. He'd play one, on Monday night he'd play in Mandeville. On Saturday night, Tuesday…

Any other questions? Dick, do we want to finish up with Mandeville? No, I don't think I think we better get on out. All right, unless you have something you want to add about your life to fill out something in a minute?
